summary: An unusually clean session: the agent read the spec, the React Router skill, the tests and the API data shapes before writing a line, pinned 8.5.1 via the npm registry, and produced a full SSR framework-mode app that passed all 54 acceptance tests on the first run with zero fix cycles. Verification was proportionate and re-run in full after its one post-pass edit, including browser screenshots compared against the design references. The only waste was a four-turn detour installing image tooling it never needed and a self-inflicted pkill, costing roughly five turns of a 49-turn budget.
